mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_date AS ledger_date, policy_no AS policy_no, product_name AS product_name, insurance_company AS insurance_company, applicant, insured, premium, revenue_confirmed, revenue_voucher_id FROM jonlink_insurance_ledger WHERE id = #{policyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE jonlink_insurance_ledger SET revenue_confirmed = #{confirmed}, revenue_voucher_id = #{voucherId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{policyId}
